item.subject: maths
item.stem: Adil measures $\angle AOB$ in the diagram. The marked size is $135^{\circ}$.

options.A: Call it acute, treating $135^{\circ}$ as less than $90^{\circ}$.
options.B: First study the decorative history of angle names before classifying $135^{\circ}$.
options.D: It is "$135$", because that numeral is printed largest in the diagram.
